summary: One-cell gate writes .done into production OUT_ROOT (or crashes on the <4-contexts guard), so the un-forced Phase-2 sweep skips the first cell — shipping it as a 1x1 fixture or aborting the whole run
evidence: issue813_dispatch.sh:108-113 runs run_cell with --max-contexts 1 --max-questions 1 --force against production OUT_ROOT; issue813_run_cell.py:380 skips if sentinel exists and not --force, :458 raises if len(kept)<4 (the gate's 1 ctx trips this under set -euo pipefail), :516-532 writes .done; issue813_dispatch.py:130-155 _cell_cmd never passes --force to Phase-2. Fix: isolated temp out-root or --gate-only mode (no sentinel/summary), or delete gate outputs before Phase 2.
